data.title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI

content.basic: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.

data.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok

content.basic: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.
